name: agentops-sdk-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is AgentOps, a Python SDK for observing AI agents built on OpenTelemetry: `agentops.init()`
and its configuration (keyword arguments and `AGENTOPS_*` environment variables), traces started with
`start_trace()`/`end_trace()` or used as context managers, trace metadata and tags, the `@trace`, `@agent`,
`@operation`/`@task`, `@workflow`, `@tool`, `@guardrail` and `@track_endpoint` decorators and the spans they
record, and the serialization, environment and validation helpers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the AgentOps Python SDK core: the modules agentops/__init__.py, agentops/config.py, agentops/enums.py, agentops/exceptions.py and agentops/validation.py, every module under agentops/sdk/, agentops/client/, agentops/helpers/ and agentops/logging/, and the agentops/semconv/ modules __init__.py, span_kinds.py, span_attributes.py, core.py, resource.py, agent.py, tool.py and workflow.py; together with the documentation pages docs/v2/concepts/core-concepts.mdx, decorators.mdx, spans.mdx, tags.mdx, traces.mdx and host-env.mdx, the documentation pages docs/v2/usage/trace-decorator.mdx, context-managers.mdx, manual-trace-control.mdx, sdk-reference.mdx, advanced-configuration.mdx, recording-operations.mdx, tracking-agents.mdx and track-endpoint-decorator.mdx, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
